WORKLOG - task 1 of snowsports_school_desk (env/ski_resort_operator), revision 2.

STEP 0 - DRAW AND ASSET LEDGER.
scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0004_ski_resort_operator/tasks/snowsports_school_desk --task 1 printed:
  {"task": 1, "key": "ski_resort_operator/snowsports_school_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 4]}
A tree of two prerequisite problems and three problems in all. The count of 6 went to
lessons_ext_session_tuition_charge, the 5 to lessons_ext_date_change_fee and the 4 to
lessons_ext_lift_access_addon.
Occupied by task 0 and untouchable here: lessons_ext_weather_session_credit and
lessons_ext_balance_settlement, with the tools issue_weather_session_credit_1ce20aea and
settle_school_balance_78bdef11, i.e. the write subjects lessons_credit_issue and lessons_payment and
the base lineages lessons_cancellation, lessons_session_delivery, lessons_payment_terms and
lessons_credit_use. This task claims the write subjects lessons_reschedule, lessons_tuition_charge and
lessons_equipment_addon with the base lineages lessons_change_terms,
lessons_agg_household_group_pricing and lessons_pricing, and the three tools
raise_session_tuition_charge_38aef0d5, raise_lift_access_addon_aea17349 and
confirm_lesson_date_change_58e66cab. The two tasks' policy sets and tool sets are disjoint and
together cover all five extended policies.

DESIGN THESIS. Surface goal: a parent rings on the Wednesday before the family flies out to move her
daughter's Sunday semi-private to the Monday. The scored core parameter is what the move costs, and
the school account it is worked out from is incomplete in two ways the customer knows nothing about.
The published change terms say, in the policy's own words, that "The share of the tuition standing that is added to the fee is fixed only after the school account carries the tuition entry due for the booking." and that "The
handling amount for re-arranging what the school laid on is worked out only once the school account
carries the add-on entry due for the lift access the session date requires." The records bear both
out: the booking stands confirmed with a block loaded and a rental add-on raised, but no tuition entry
at all, and the participant holds no season pass and no ticket order for the session date, so the lift
access the lesson day needs has never been put on the booking either. The agent must raise the
tuition, raise the lift access, and only then work out and hand over the change fee.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD.
  root problem      lessons_ext_date_change_fee (target confirm_lesson_date_change_58e66cab, owner=user)
  prerequisite 1    lessons_ext_session_tuition_charge (target raise_session_tuition_charge_38aef0d5, agent)
  prerequisite 2    lessons_ext_lift_access_addon (target raise_lift_access_addon_aea17349, agent)
  edge  lessons_ext_date_change_fee <- lessons_ext_session_tuition_charge
    kind value_input; gate tuition_standing (a compute binding of the blocked policy); form state
    prerequisite sentence: "The share of the booking's value that is added to the fee is fixed only after the school account carries the tuition entry due for the booking."
    four-point test: (1) "only after" joins this policy's own result - the share added to the fee, and so
      the fee - to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state, a tuition entry
      standing on the school account, in the words the school account finder prints, with no action,
      performer or tool named; (3) no tool, policy id, snake_case token or row id appears; (4) it is a
      hard requirement over exactly the state the edge's condition names.
    exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: raise_session_tuition_charge_38aef0d5
      is the only action in the charter that books a tuition entry, and
      lessons_ext_session_tuition_charge the only policy that computes one.
    derivation: the sentence says the share added to the fee waits on a tuition entry. The account shows a block load and
      a rental add-on and nothing else, and the booking record shows 59.00 still to be collected on a
      Semi-Private Coaching Session, which no reader takes for the price of the lesson. The tuition
      policy's own rule fixes what the tuition raised for a booking is. One reading only: raise the
      tuition, then settle the change.
    unresolved at frozen_time: no lessons_ledger row of event_type lessons_tuition_charge stands on
      the booking, and lessons_holdings.tuition_balance_usd = 59.00, exactly the rental add-on.
    deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skipping the tuition write leaves the scored change fee at
      105.00 instead of 131.87 - and the amount, not merely its existence, reaches the fee: the share
      is taken on a figure reckoned on the tuition standing, so any other lawful tuition figure gives
      another fee (500.00 -> 117.37, 553.22 -> 131.87, 700.00 -> 137.74, recomputed).
  edge  lessons_ext_date_change_fee <- lessons_ext_lift_access_addon
    kind value_input; gate addon_entries (a compute binding of the blocked policy); form state
    prerequisite sentence: "The handling amount for re-arranging what the school laid on is worked out
      only once the school account carries the add-on entry due for the lift access the session date
      requires."
    four-point test: (1) "only once" joins this policy's own result - the handling amount that enters
      the fee - to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state, an add-on entry
      standing on the school account; (3) no tool, policy id or code token; (4) the scope is exactly
      the lift access entry the session date requires, no wider.
    exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: raise_lift_access_addon_aea17349 is
      the only action that books a lift access add-on entry.
    derivation: the account shows one add-on entry and it is a rental, not lift access; the pass
      records and the ticket records show nothing for this household, so the lift access policy's own
      rule - a participant holding neither an active season pass nor a ticket order carrying a ski day
      for the session date cannot reach the teaching terrain - says the entry is due.
    unresolved at frozen_time: the only lessons_ledger add-on row carries charge_category
      rental_addon, and no passes_holdings and no tickets_holdings row is seeded for this household.
    deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skipping the lift access write leaves the scored change fee at
      117.49 instead of 131.87: one add-on entry rather than two puts the handling amount a tier lower
      and the add-ons the booking's value is reckoned on fall from 118.60 to 59.00.
  topological order: the two prerequisites in either order, then the root.
  order uniqueness: proved by running both orders in Step 5. The tuition computation reads the
    booking's dates, the school request record, the block loaded and the lodging reservation and its
    folio, and never the add-on entries; the lift access computation reads the block loaded, the
    add-on entries, the session date and the lodging reservation, and never the tuition entries.
    Neither write touches the other's inputs, both raise the same holding field by addition, and both
    mint their row ids from their own arguments, so the two orders give identical terminal hashes -
    the recorded run printed "commute equal: True" - and both scored parameters are unchanged.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
  Write 1 - subject lessons_tuition_charge. Governing base policies:
  lessons_agg_household_group_pricing, which has no eligibility gate and contributes its scope -
  bookings made together by one household are priced as a group, judged at the moment the tuition is
  raised; the household holds one live school booking, so no group of two or more participants
  starting on the same date arises and no group reduction is taken - and lessons_pricing, gate
  chargeable_booking_state, kind state: "Tuition is raised only while the booking record stands in the
  requested, waitlisted, confirmed or in_progress state." The booking stands confirmed, so it holds.
  Write 2 - subject lessons_equipment_addon. The only governing base policy is lessons_pricing, whose
  single eligibility gate applies_to lessons_tuition_charge, so nothing gate-scoped attaches to this
  write and what is inherited is the policy's scope: add-ons are raised as their own entries, one for
  each kind and each session date, and an add-on already included in the product is never raised. The
  Semi-Private Coaching Session includes no lift ticket, and no lift access entry stands.
  Write 3 - subject lessons_reschedule. The only governing base policy is lessons_change_terms, gate
  move_notice_deadline, kind time: "A move to another date is accepted only when it is recorded on or
  before the move deadline, which is the product's notice period measured back from the moment the
  first session is due to start." anchor_event "the first session is due to start"; anchor_source
  lessons_holdings.first_session_date = 2027-02-14 with session_time 10:00; relation not_after;
  duration_source variants.reschedule_notice_hours = 48; unit elapsed_hours; boundary inclusive;
  counting rule: whole elapsed hours on the mountain's local clock subtracted from the scheduled
  start. 2027-02-14 10:00 less 48 hours is 2027-02-12 10:00. frozen_time is 2027-02-10 08:30, so the
  move is inside the deadline with about 97.5 elapsed hours of notice. Positive boundary: 2027-02-12
  10:00 is still inside, the boundary being inclusive. Negative boundary: 2027-02-12 11:00 is past it,
  and the correct handling would then be to refuse the move and put the cancellation terms to the
  household, so the write would not be scheduled. The gate transferee_named on the same base policy
  applies_to lessons_transfer and is not in play. The product allows two moves and none has been used.
  lessons_pricing is additionally cited in the change policy's lineage because the fee reads the
  tuition standing on the booking; it governs no part of the reschedule write.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The narrowest object is one school booking: the Semi-Private Coaching Session
registered to Anoushka Raval, first session 2027-02-14 at 10:00. Every ledger row that enters a sum or
a count carries that booking's lesson_id: the block-load entry of one session, the rental add-on of
59.00 for the session date 2027-02-14, and, once written, the tuition entry and the lift access entry
of this task. Both school service requests are correlated by lesson_id; only the one whose outcome is
confirmed is counted, the withdrawn one being the near-miss. The lodging reservation and its folio
belong to the same household and are read only: the change policy reads the reservation's state and
departure date, the tuition policy its state, rate plan and the deposit charged on its folio, and the
lift access policy its state and rate plan. Nothing is written outside the school tables, and the
household holds no second school booking.

STEP 1 - POLICIES.
  Forward sweep rule -> compute_basis -> compute: every binding of all three policies that reads the
  world, aggregates, chooses or rounds carries a verbatim quotation in compute_basis. On the tuition
  policy: base_price, advance_days, advance_points, stay_deposit, stay_status, stay_points,
  selection_status, taken_points, after_reduction, instructor_confirmed, instructor_pending,
  instructor_charge, sessions_loaded, place_supplement, window_status, stay_rate_plan,
  window_supplement and result. On the lift access policy: sessions_loaded, load_entries,
  access_basis, days_to_session, advance_points, stay_status, stay_rate_plan, stay_ticket_points,
  addon_entries, bundle_points, total_points and result. On the change policy: days_of_notice,
  notice_fee, addon_entries, addon_handling, instructor_requests, instructor_rebooking, raw_fee,
  stay_status, stay_departure, moved_fee, tuition_standing, value_share, value_component and result.
  Reverse sweep compute -> rule: every load-bearing sentence of each rule is claimed by a binding, and
  every filter in an expression is carried by its quotation - each event_type filter, each outcome
  filter on the request record, each calendar-day count and each ternary. The tuition rule pins the
  acting base and the order: the points reduction acts on the block price and on nothing else, the
  three additions land on what it leaves, and the rounding happens once at the end. The lift access
  rule pins that the three point reductions are first combined into one total and applied once, never
  one after another. The change rule pins that the notice fee, the handling amount and the rebooking
  amount are added together, that the figure that leaves is settled on the count, that the share of
  the tuition standing is added last of all, and that the rounding happens once at the end.
  overwrite declarations: the tuition policy supersedes two sentences of lessons_pricing - the one
  that fixes how tuition is built, and the one that orders the passholder and group reductions, which
  this policy replaces with reductions of its own; the lift access policy supersedes lessons_pricing's
  sentence on add-ons being raised at the product's add-on prices, and restates in its own rule the
  part of that sentence it keeps; the change policy supersedes lessons_change_terms' sentence that
  each move carries the product's move fee. Each names the base sentence and the replacing sentence
  verbatim, and none quotes an eligibility gate's condition, so chargeable_booking_state and
  move_notice_deadline both stay in force and are inherited into solvability_contract.

FACTOR CARD - lessons_ext_session_tuition_charge (6 factors: 5 parameter, 1 method).
  advance_rate_points (parameter, decides advance_points): the early booking points where the booking
    was recorded fourteen or more days ahead and the product is sold a hundred and twenty days ahead
    or further; the ahead booking points where it is sold less far ahead; none otherwise. Booked
    2027-01-28 for 2027-02-14 is 17 days, and the Semi-Private is sold up to 120 days ahead, so 8
    points against a baseline of none. Baseline result: 597.14.
  resort_stay_points (parameter, cross_difficulty=lodging, decides stay_points): the long stay points
    where a confirmed lodging reservation stands and the deposit charged on its folio reaches a
    thousand dollars; the short stay points where it falls below; none where no confirmed reservation
    stands. The Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence stands confirmed and its folio carries a deposit
    charge of 1877.04, so 14 points against a baseline of none. Baseline result: 630.08.
  reduction_selection_method (method, cross_difficulty=lodging, decides taken_points): which of the
    two reductions the school actually takes - both combined into one total where a confirmed
    reservation stands and the booking was recorded fourteen or more days ahead; the stay points alone
    where a confirmed reservation stands and it was recorded later than that; the advance points alone
    where no confirmed reservation stands. Both conditions hold, so the two are combined, 22 points.
    The tiers change which quantities enter the computation, not merely which number: the fall-through
    computes on the advance points alone. Baseline reading: the advance points alone, and result
    630.08.
  named_instructor_charge (parameter, decides instructor_charge): the product's instructor request fee
    where a confirmed request stands; the provisional instructor charge where one stands accepted
    pending confirmation; nothing where none stands. One confirmed request stands, so 75.00 against a
    baseline of nothing. Baseline result: 478.22.
  place_hold_supplement (parameter, decides place_supplement): the long block supplement where the
    block loaded holds three or more sessions, the short block supplement where it holds one or two,
    nothing where no block has been loaded. One session was loaded, so 20.00. Baseline result: 533.22.
  rate_window_supplement (parameter, cross_difficulty=lodging, decides window_supplement): the holiday
    window supplement where a confirmed reservation is priced on the holiday window, the peak window
    supplement where it is priced on the peak window, nothing otherwise. The reservation is priced on
    the peak window, so 30.00. Its bindings declare both the reservation's state and its rate plan,
    which is what its tiers rest on. Baseline result: 523.22.
  Scored value 553.22. Whole-baseline fall-back: 549.00, which is exactly what a reader computes from
  baseline.rule alone - the product's block price with no reduction earned and nothing added.
  Near-miss: the withdrawn instructor request of 2027-01-28, which a careless reader counts and the
  outcome filter excludes; and the folio's balance payment of 4379.76, which a reader who summed the
  folio would add to the 1877.04 deposit charge the binding is filtered to.

FACTOR CARD - lessons_ext_lift_access_addon (4 factors: 3 parameter, 1 method).
  session_length_method (method, decides access_basis): the price in full for each session the block
    loaded where a block stands and the session runs four hours or more; at the half day share for
    each session the block loaded where a block stands and the session runs fewer than four hours; in
    full for each session the booking holds where no block stands. A block stands and the Semi-Private
    runs three hours, so 149.00 becomes 74.50. Baseline result: 119.20.
  advance_purchase_points (parameter, decides advance_points): the advance ticket points where the
    session is seven or more days off, the near ticket points where it is one to six days off, the
    window ticket points where it falls on the handling date or has passed. Four days off, so 5 points
    against a baseline of none. Baseline result: 63.33.
  resort_guest_ticket_points (parameter, cross_difficulty=lodging, decides stay_ticket_points): the
    holiday stay points where a confirmed reservation is priced on the holiday window, the peak stay
    points where it is priced on the peak window, none otherwise. Peak, so 10 points. Baseline result:
    67.05.
  extras_bundle_points (parameter, decides bundle_points): the full bundle points where two or more
    add-on entries already stand, the part bundle points where exactly one stands, none where none
    stands. The rental add-on is the one entry standing, so 5 points. Baseline result: 63.33.
  Scored value 59.60. Whole-baseline fall-back: 149.00, which is exactly what a reader computes from
  baseline.rule alone - the lift ticket add-on price times the sessions the booking holds.

FACTOR CARD - lessons_ext_date_change_fee (5 factors: 4 parameter, 1 method).
  notice_band_fee (parameter, decides notice_fee): the long notice fee where the first session is
    seven or more days off, the mid notice fee where it is three to six days off, the product's move
    fee where it is fewer than three days off. Four days off, so 35.00 against a baseline of the
    product's move fee, 45.00. Baseline result: 79.63.
  addon_rearrangement (parameter, decides addon_handling): the multi add-on handling where two or more
    add-on entries stand, the single add-on handling where exactly one stands, nothing where none
    stands. Once the lift access entry has been raised two stand, so 30.00. Baseline result: 59.63.
  instructor_rebooking_amount (parameter, decides instructor_rebooking): the named instructor
    rebooking amount where a confirmed request stands and an instructor is written on the booking; the
    pending amount where a confirmed request stands and none is written; nothing where no confirmed
    request stands. The request stands confirmed and Camille Roux is written on the booking, so 40.00.
    Baseline result: 54.63.
  moved_value_method (method, decides value_base): which quantities the booking's value is reckoned
    on - the tuition standing divided by the sessions the block loaded where a block stands holding
    more than one session; the tuition standing together with the add-ons standing on the booking
    where a block stands holding a single session; the tuition standing alone where no block stands.
    The tiers select three different expressions over record-derived quantities rather than three
    constants over one expression. A block of one session stands, so the value is reckoned on
    553.22 + 118.60 = 671.82. Baseline reading: the tuition standing alone, 553.22, and result 127.13.
  booking_value_share (parameter, decides value_share): the large booking share where the tuition
    standing reaches the product's session price, the small booking share where it is above nothing
    but short of it, nothing where no tuition stands. Once the tuition entry has been raised 553.22
    stands against a session price of 549.00, so 4 per cent of 671.82, 26.8728, is added. Baseline
    result: 105.00.
  Scored value 131.87. Whole-baseline fall-back: 45.00, which is exactly what a reader computes from
  baseline.rule alone - the Semi-Private's move fee, with the booking's value reckoned on the tuition
  standing alone and no share earned. The two readings of the baseline agree.
  Multi-source: instructor_rebooking_amount, moved_value_method, and on the tuition policy
  advance_rate_points, resort_stay_points and reduction_selection_method - each combines two
  conditions over distinct evidence by "and" on every tier beyond the fall-through.

STEP 3 - SEED. Why each class of row exists, and what changes without it.
  customers: the household account.
  lodging_holdings: the Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence, confirmed, eight peak nights from 2027-02-12
    to 2027-02-20. It is the holding four cross-difficulty factors test. Its figures are what the
    lodging charter itself fixes for that reservation: eight nights inside the peak window
    (2027-01-03 to 2027-03-14) at 869.00, no extra-person charge (four guests at a standard occupancy
    of four), no passholder reduction (the household holds no pass), no advance booking reduction
    (2026-12-19 to 2027-02-12 is 55 days, short of the 90-day minimum) and a length-of-stay reduction
    of 10.00 per cent (eight nights against a threshold of seven), giving a room rate of
    8 x 869.00 x 0.90 = 6256.80; the deposit is the unit type's 30.00 per cent of that, 1877.04; the
    deposit falls due five calendar days from the day the unit was put on hold, 2026-12-19 counting as
    day zero, i.e. 2026-12-24; and the whole stay is loaded as nights when the reservation becomes
    firm, so nights_remaining is 8.
  lodging_folio: the deposit charge of 1877.04, which books to the deposit account and leaves
    deposit_held_usd at 1877.04; the nights load of 8, which books to the nights account; and the
    balance payment of 4379.76 - the room rate less the deposit - made on 2027-01-20, inside the
    21-day-before-arrival balance date of 2027-01-22, which books to the folio account and leaves
    folio_balance_usd at -4379.76, the stay being paid ahead of the nightly charges that post during
    it. Every holding field equals the sum of the signed deltas booked to its own account.
  lessons_holdings: the booking. booked_date 2027-01-28 and first_session_date 2027-02-14 drive the
    advance count of the tuition and the notice count of the fee; instructor_name decides the
    rebooking tier; sessions_booked is the fall-back count of the lift access basis; and
    tuition_balance_usd of 59.00 - the rental add-on and nothing else - is the visible sign that no
    tuition has been raised. The booking was recorded 2027-01-28, so the Semi-Private's balance period
    of 14 calendar days puts the balance due on 2027-02-11, the day after the handling date: nothing
    has yet fallen due unpaid and base's clause that puts the place at risk has not bitten.
  lessons_ledger: the block-load entry of one session, read by three factors across two policies, and
    the rental add-on of 59.00 for the session date, the single add-on entry standing at the opening.
    The balance of 59.00 equals the sum of the signed deltas exactly, so there is no cache trap.
  lessons_requests: the instructor request registered 2027-01-29 with an outcome of confirmed, which
    the instructor charge and the rebooking amount rest on, and a second instructor request registered
    2027-01-28 whose outcome is withdrawn - the near-miss the outcome filters exclude.
  Deliberately absent: any passes_holdings or tickets_holdings row for this household. That absence is
    the world fact the lift access policy keys on, and the persona confirms it when asked.
  Automatic clauses checked row by row: the school's automatic clauses are the block load on a firm
  booking, the draw of a session on delivery, the move to the delivered state when the block runs out
  and the close when nothing is outstanding. The block is loaded and nothing is delivered, so the
  booking stays confirmed with one session remaining; something is outstanding, so it cannot close. On
  the lodging side the deposit is charged and the balance settled, the nights are loaded and the stay
  has not begun, so no lodging obligation is lit and no room or resort charge is yet due.

STEP 4 - PERSONA. Priya is written as an organised parent packing at home two days before the flight.
  Volunteered at the opening: who she is, that her daughter has a semi-private on the Sunday the
  fourteenth, that she needs to move that lesson to the Monday the fifteenth, that the desk may tidy up
  anything on its own side, and that she wants to press the button herself on any charge for moving it.
  Given only when asked: the mobile she calls from, the email she books under, her date of birth, the
  participant's name, age and ability, that they are staying in the Slopeside two-bedroom from the
  Friday for eight nights, that Anoushka holds no season pass and no lift ticket for that week, and
  that they asked for Camille Roux when they booked; she says she has no reference numbers. Reacted to
  only after the agent speaks: she asks for any figure she is read to be checked against the record
  because the confirmation email she was sent when she booked had a different number on it - the same
  reaction whatever figure is quoted, and she never says what the email said; she accepts a report
  that the account has been looked over; she confirms the move herself once it is handed to her; and
  she closes once she has been told the lesson now runs on the Monday. Her last reaction answers the
  last gold action and asks for nothing beyond it.

STEP 5 - VERIFICATION. The three computations were recomputed on their own handling-time worlds with
  the gate's own evaluator over this initial_state:
    C lessons_ext_session_tuition_charge on initial_state -> 553.22 (2 history rows, 17 branches)
      factor baselines: advance_rate_points 597.14, resort_stay_points 630.08,
      reduction_selection_method 630.08, named_instructor_charge 478.22, place_hold_supplement 533.22,
      rate_window_supplement 523.22; all-baseline 549.0
    write: raise_session_tuition_charge_38aef0d5(lesson_id, 553.22) -> 612.22 still to be collected
    B lessons_ext_lift_access_addon on that world -> 59.6 (2 history rows, 10 branches)
      factor baselines: session_length_method 119.2, advance_purchase_points 63.33,
      resort_guest_ticket_points 67.05, extras_bundle_points 63.33; all-baseline 149.0
    write: raise_lift_access_addon_aea17349(lesson_id, 59.6, 2027-02-14) -> 671.82 still to be collected
    A lessons_ext_date_change_fee on that world -> 131.87 (5 history rows, 10 branches)
      factor baselines: notice_band_fee 141.87, addon_rearrangement 101.87,
      instructor_rebooking_amount 91.87, moved_value_method 127.13, booking_value_share 105.0;
      all-baseline 45.0
    prerequisite sensitivity: A with the tuition write skipped -> 105.0; A with the lift access write
      skipped -> 117.49; both against 131.87 with them. Varying the tuition entry alone and
      recomputing the root: 500.00 -> 117.37, 553.22 -> 131.87, 700.00 -> 137.74.
    order: running the lift access write first and the tuition write second and hashing the result
      printed "commute equal: True" against the recorded order, both scored parameters unchanged.
    write: confirm_lesson_date_change_58e66cab(lesson_id, 2027-02-15, 131.87) -> first session now
      2027-02-15, moves used 1, 803.69 still to be collected.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate the household by the mobile she is calling on and verify her on the email
and the date of birth. Read the booking, the school account entries, the school service requests, the
season passes and the ticket orders (both empty, which is what makes the lift access due), the lodging
reservation and its folio. Read the change terms and find the two sentences that make the fee wait on
a tuition entry and on the lift access add-on entry. Raise the tuition: the block price 549.00; the
booking was recorded 17 days ahead and the product is sold 120 days ahead, so 8 advance points, and a
confirmed reservation with a folio deposit charge of 1877.04 earns 14 stay points; both conditions of
the selection hold, so the two are combined into 22 points and the block price is reduced once,
giving 428.22; plus the instructor request fee of 75.00 for the confirmed named-instructor request,
plus the short block supplement of 20.00 for the single session loaded, plus the peak window
supplement of 30.00, giving 553.22. Raise the lift access: 149.00 taken at the half day share for the
one session loaded because the session runs three hours, giving 74.50, reduced once by the combined 20
points - 5 for a session four days off, 10 for a peak-window stay, 5 for the one add-on already
standing - giving 59.60, on the date the booking's first session stands on, 2027-02-14. Then the fee:
35.00 for four days of notice, plus 30.00 of handling for the two add-on entries now standing, plus
40.00 to free the named instructor, giving 105.00; a block of one session stands, so the booking's
value is reckoned on the tuition standing together with the add-ons standing on it, 553.22 + 118.60 =
671.82; the tuition standing of 553.22 reaches the session price of 549.00, so the large booking
share of 4 per cent of 671.82, 26.8728, is added; 131.87 is handed to the household to confirm along
with the new date.

EASY MISTAKES. Charging the product's flat move fee of 45.00 and stopping. Working the fee out before

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel out-edges of the same problem and may be taken in either order. The run of Step 5 took them the other way round - the lift access write first, then the tuition write - and hashed the resulting database against the recorded order: the hashes were identical (the run printed 'commute equal: True'), and both scored parameters were unchanged, 553.22 and 59.60. The reason is structural: the tuition computation reads the booking's dates, the school request record, the block loaded and the lodging reservation and its folio, and never the add-on entries; the lift access computation reads the block loaded, the add-on entries, the session date and the lodging reservation, and never the tuition entries. Both writes raise the same holding field by addition, which commutes, and both mint their row ids from their own arguments, so neither order can produce a different row.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the tuition write and replaying everything else unchanged leaves the tuition standing on the booking at 0.00, so the booking value share falls to the fall-through of nothing, no share of the booking's value is added, and the scored change_fee_usd moves from 131.87 to 105.00. The amount matters and not merely its existence: the share is 4 per cent of a figure reckoned on the tuition standing, so a different lawful tuition figure gives a different fee - 500.00 gives 117.37, 700.00 gives 137.74. The terminal state differs twice over: the tuition entry is missing and the fee entry carries the wrong amount.

Skipping the lift access write and replaying everything else unchanged leaves one add-on entry standing rather than two, so the handling amount falls from the multi add-on handling of 30.00 to the single add-on handling of 18.00 and the add-ons the booking's value is reckoned on fall from 118.60 to 59.00; the scored change_fee_usd moves from 131.87 to 117.49, and the add-on entry itself is missing from the terminal state.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario nowhere names either prerequisite problem, the missing tuition entry, the lift access add-on or any suggestion that the account has to be put right first. Priya volunteers only that her daughter has a semi-private on the Sunday the fourteenth, that she needs to move that lesson to the Monday the fifteenth, that the desk may tidy up whatever belongs at its own end, and that she wants to agree to any charge herself. The facts that bear on the prerequisites reach the agent only as answers to questions the agent asks - that they are staying in the Slopeside two-bedroom, that Anoushka holds no season pass and no lift ticket, that they asked for Camille Roux - and each of those is a plain answer about the household's own circumstances, not a pointer to a policy or an action. Her passive reaction to a report that the account has been looked over names no kind of write, and her one unprompted reaction to a figure, that the confirmation email she was sent when she booked had a different number on it, is the same whatever figure is quoted and never says what the email said, so it distinguishes a correct agent from a wrong one in no way.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: confirm_lesson_date_change_58e66cab in task_tools.py reads the booking row with ctx.find, writes a school fee entry carrying the fee it was handed, rewrites the first session date, counts the move and raises the amount outstanding. It never looks at tuition entries or add-on entries, compares nothing, raises no error and returns the same shaped receipt whether or not the two prerequisite writes have landed. raise_session_tuition_charge_38aef0d5 and raise_lift_access_addon_aea17349 likewise read the booking row, write their entry and raise the figure outstanding with no check of any kind.
